nodes.summary: For a vertex set $S$, $P(S) = \sum_{v \in S} \deg_S(v)$ is the number of ordered pairs of adjacent vertices of $S$, twice the number of edges induced by $S$. It is at most $|S|^2$. For the whole vertex set it equals $2|E(G)|$, by the handshake lemma.
nodes.title: Ordered adjacent pairs inside a vertex set

nodes.summary: For a graph $G$ on $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, a vertex set $S$ and a vertex $v$, $\deg_S(v)$ is the number of neighbours of $v$ that lie in $S$. When $v \in S$ this is the degree of $v$ in the subgraph induced by $S$.
nodes.title: Degree inside a vertex set

nodes.summary: If $H$ is not $r$-colourable, where $r \ge 1$, then $\mathrm{ex}(n, K_{r+1}) \le \mathrm{ex}(n, H)$ for every $n$. Mathlib's `SimpleGraph.extremalNumber_top` identifies $\mathrm{ex}(n, K_{r+1})$ with the number of edges of the Turán graph $T(n, r)$. That graph is $r$-colourable, so it contains no copy of $H$.
nodes.title: Extremal numbers dominate those of cliques

nodes.summary: If $\chi(H) = r + 1$ with $r \ge 1$, then $\pi(H) \ge 1 - 1/r$. A graph with chromatic number $r + 1$ is not $r$-colourable, so this follows from the lower bound on the Turán density. Here $H$ may have any vertex type.
nodes.title: Lower bound on the Turán density, chromatic form

nodes.summary: For $r \ge 1$, the Turán graph $T(n, r)$ on $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is properly coloured by $v \mapsto v \bmod r$. In Mathlib's definition, two vertices are adjacent exactly when their residues mod $r$ differ, so each residue class is independent. These classes are the $r$ parts of the complete $r$-partite graph $T(n, r)$.
nodes.title: Turán graphs are `r`-colourable

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
